name: Matty
source:
Due to certain circumstances, Ryouta was sent to live with his parent’s relatives, becoming a freeloader of the Okano household. However, in this house, he is treated as nothing more than the “youngest child”.

As the youngest child, he is constantly teased, submitted to unreasonable requests, and sent to do errands. However, he is simply not in a position where he can refuse.

The eldest daughter and office lady, Sena; the second daughter and tomboy, Kana; and the youngest daughter and his classmate, Mana. These three, without exception, do as much as they like with their new younger brother. On the other hand, his aunt Kaori dotes excessively on him.

In the middle of such an exciting daily life, embarrassing and fortunate events occur…what will happen to Ryouta?

From [url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url].
translation:
由于某些原因，吉永良太被送到父母的亲戚家，寄住在冈野家。然而在这个家里，他只被当作“最小的孩子”。

作为家中老幺，他总是遭人捉弄、被提出无理要求，还要不停跑腿。可寄人篱下的他根本没有拒绝的余地。

身为公司职员的长女冈野濑奈、假小子性格的次女冈野加奈，以及与他同班的幼女冈野真奈——三人无一例外，都随心所欲地摆弄这个新来的弟弟。另一方面，姨母冈野香织又对他宠爱过度。

在这令人心跳不已的日常之中，既羞耻又幸运的意外接连发生……良太最终会迎来什么？

[摘自[url=https://j-addicts.de/vn-of-the-month-december-2003/]j-addicts[/url]]
